# Élan Summit

> A student summit built around leadership, creative activities and meeting people from other schools.

The first edition took place on 5 and 6 September 2026 at SGIS Pune Campus, Mulshi, Pune. The next edition will feature Crisis Command. Its dates, venue, eligibility and prices have not been announced. Archived 2026 prices and rules must not be presented as current registration details.

## Official pages

- [Élan Summit | Student Leadership & Crisis Command](https://elansummit.com/): Élan Summit brings students together to lead, create and connect. Explore Crisis Command, revisit our first edition and apply to help organise Élan 2027.
- [About Élan Summit | Our Story](https://elansummit.com/about): Learn how Élan Summit began and what students can experience through its cabinet simulation, creative activities and school community.
- [Next Edition & Registration Updates | Élan Summit](https://elansummit.com/next-edition): Follow plans for the next Élan Summit, featuring Crisis Command. Dates, venue, eligibility and registration details will be announced when confirmed.
- [Crisis Command | Élan Summit](https://elansummit.com/flagship): Explore Crisis Command, Élan Summit’s cabinet simulation. Take a leadership role, respond to a crisis and work with your team to defend a decision.
- [Founder & Co-founders | Élan Summit](https://elansummit.com/founders): Meet Akshit Parmar, founder of Élan Summit, and co-founders Sakshi Baldawa, Prachi Belagali and Jacinth Jebaraj.
- [Contact the Team | Élan Summit](https://elansummit.com/contact): Contact the Élan Summit team about school participation, volunteering, partnerships or the first edition. Find the director’s contact details here.
- [2026 Archive | Élan Summit](https://elansummit.com/archive): Explore the Élan Summit 2026 archive: photographs, guests, competitions, programme and original event details from 5 and 6 September in Mulshi, Pune.
- [Élan Summit 2026 in Pictures](https://elansummit.com/first-edition): Revisit Élan Summit 2026 through photographs of the opening ceremony, committee sessions, DJ night, closing ceremony and felicitations.
- [2026 Organising Committee | Élan Summit](https://elansummit.com/oc-2026): Explore the departments and members of the Élan Summit 2026 organising committee in Mulshi.
- [Apply for the 2027 Organising Committee | Élan Summit](https://elansummit.com/join-oc-2027): Apply to help organise Élan Summit 2027. Tell the team about your interests, availability and preferred responsibilities.
- [Cabinet Preview](https://elansummit.com/cabinet-preview): Try one fictional Crisis Command decision and explore what your cabinet might ask next.
- [2026 Guests & Judges | Élan Summit](https://elansummit.com/guests): Meet the guests, judges and school leaders associated with Élan Summit’s first edition in September 2026.
- [Frequently Asked Questions | Élan Summit](https://elansummit.com/faqs): Answers to questions about the next Élan Summit, Crisis Command, school participation, volunteering and registration announcements.

## Accounts

Participant and organiser pages require appropriate account access and are not public reference sources.
